description: Brute force attack progressing to credential compromise and lateral movement to Domain Controller

alerts.description: Over 120 failed Kerberos authentication attempts detected within 3 minutes targeting user asmith from an external IP.
Logon event 4624 succeeded for account asmith immediately following brute force cluster from same external IP.
Remote administrative share ADMIN$ mounted on Primary Domain Controller DC-01 followed by PsExec service creation under asmith.

description: Phishing spear-mail yielding macro/script malware execution and persistent C2 beaconing

alerts.description: Inbound malicious email with attachment 'Invoice_Overdue_Oct2026.xlsm' bypassed basic gateway filter and opened by user rcooper.
EXCEL.EXE spawned powershell.exe with base64 encoded payload downloading staged binary from staging host.
Periodic HTTPS beaconing traffic observed every 60 seconds with jitter to suspicious unregistered dynamic DNS domain.

description: Local privilege escalation on database host leading to unauthorized archive and external exfiltration

alerts.description: Local token manipulation and abuse of elevation control mechanisms (SeImpersonatePrivilege) by appuser resulting in SYSTEM privilege acquisition.
Encrypted 7z archive of customer transaction table streamed via high-bandwidth outbound SFTP to an unapproved foreign IP.

description: Noisy low-priority false-positive alerts from routine maintenance and security scans

alerts.description: Scheduled weekly vulnerability port scan on VLAN 2 from authorized internal scanner host.
Approved ergonomic USB mouse plugged into front desk reception kiosk.
